part.text:
Fixed `GroupByQueryQueryToolChest.pullFromCache` to increment the post-aggregator position for each cached value instead of overwriting the first slot (`processing/.../GroupByQueryQueryToolChest.java:688`).

Before, multiple post-aggregates all wrote to the first post-agg column; now each maps to its correct position.

Validated: `GroupByQueryQueryToolChestTest` — 20 tests, 0 failures.
